question: Did the US government fund or steer the investigation?

runs.note: Russian presents the US as involved in funding the investigation. French records the same USAID grant to OCCRP alongside the US denial of editorial control. Spanish and Chinese report it as a WikiLeaks/RT accusation; English and German omit it.

Russian presents Toner’s statement as US financing of the investigation. French separates the USAID grant from involvement in the leak and explicitly includes the government’s denial of editorial control.

Russian, French, Spanish, Chinese, and Portuguese highlight allegations by WikiLeaks, Russian officials, or commentators that USAID and George Soros funded the investigation to target non-Western leaders (with Russian placing this in its 'Source of the leak' section and Portuguese dedicating a section to 'Comments on Western bias'), whereas English omits these funding allegations and only quotes John Doe's statement that he never worked for any intelligence agency.

Russian states, as Toner’s account, that the United States helped finance the investigation through USAID. French has Toner denying involvement in the leak while saying an USAID subsidy to OCCRP had no editorial control. Spanish and Chinese present US backing as a claim from an account attributed to WikiLeaks. Portuguese, citing Craig Murray, discusses foundation funding of the Center for Public Integrity rather than a US government grant. English, German, Arabic and Icelandic do not report a US-government funding claim.

The Russian version presents the WikiLeaks claim of US/Soros funding as reported data; French, Chinese, Spanish and Portuguese attribute it to WikiLeaks or commentators; English and German do not carry the claim at all.

Russian, Spanish, French, Chinese and Portuguese all report the WikiLeaks/OCCRP/USAID/Soros funding allegations (French adding the State Department's denial of editorial control); the English and German versions never mention any such claims.

statements.translation: According to State Department spokesman Mark Toner, his country is involved in funding the Panama Papers investigation through USAID funds.

statements.translation: On 7 April 2016, the US government, through spokesman Mark Toner, denied involvement in the document leak. He said it subsidized OCCRP through USAID, one of the organizations in the consortium that received the documents, but that this grant came without editorial control.

statements.quote: Esta afirmación se apoya en un mensaje de una cuenta de Twitter, atribuida a Wikileaks, que habría denunciado que Estados Unidos realizó la investigación a través del Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project y la financió la Open Society Foundations y el empresario George Soros, así como la Agencia de los Estados Unidos para el Desarrollo Internacional y que está dirigida contra Rusia.
statements.translation: This claim is supported by a message from a Twitter account, attributed to WikiLeaks, which allegedly denounced that the United States carried out the investigation through the Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project and that it was financed by the Open Society Foundations and businessman George Soros, as well as the United States Agency for International Development, and that it is directed against Russia.

statements.translation: According to the international non-profit organization WikiLeaks, George Soros and the US Agency for International Development (USAID) are behind the 'Panama Papers' leaks. difference: English, Spanish and German expressly distinguish lawful arrangements from criminal uses. The short Arabic account presents politicians’ involvement as illegal activity without a general lawful-use caveat.
question: How explicitly are lawful offshore arrangements separated from illegal uses?

runs.note: English, Spanish and German expressly distinguish lawful arrangements from criminal uses. The short Arabic account presents politicians’ involvement as illegal activity without a general lawful-use caveat.

English, Spanish, French, Chinese and Portuguese say offshore companies can be legal and that illegality depends on use. German says the files show both legal avoidance and crimes. Arabic alleges mostly illegal shelters and does not set out a legal use. Portuguese adds drug trafficking to the illegal uses. Russian and Icelandic describe hidden assets, laundering or evasion without saying that offshore companies can be lawful.

statements.quote: Although it is generally not against the law to own an offshore shell company, reporters found that some of the shell corporations were used for illegal purposes, including fraud, tax evasion, and evading international sanctions.

En estricto rigor, el mero hecho de tener relaciones de negocios o contratar consultorías con una firma panameña de abogados no constituye en sí mismo ningún delito, y dependerá de qué se realizó exactamente.
statements.translation: Strictly speaking, merely having business relations with or hiring advice from a Panamanian law firm is not itself a crime; it depends on exactly what was done.

statements.quote: Solche sogenannten Briefkastenfirmen können sowohl legalen Zwecken dienen wie der Anonymisierung von Vermögensverhältnissen oder der Steuervermeidung als auch illegalen wie der Steuerhinterziehung, der Geldwäsche oder der Umgehung von Sanktionen.
statements.translation: Such shell companies can serve legal purposes such as anonymizing ownership or tax avoidance, as well as illegal purposes such as tax evasion, money laundering or circumventing sanctions.

statements.quote: تكشف عن تورط 143 سياسيا بأعمال غير قانونية مثل التهرب الضريبي، وتبييض أموال عبر شركات عابرة للحدود، بينهم 12 من قادة العالم الحاليين والسابقين.
statements.translation: They reveal the involvement of 143 politicians in illegal activities such as tax evasion and money laundering through cross-border companies, including 12 current and former world leaders.

statements.quote: While offshore business entities are legal, reporters found that some of the Mossack Fonseca shell corporations were used for illegal purposes, including fraud, tax evasion, and evading international sanctions.
No toda empresa fantasma es ilegal. Puede utilizarse en forma perfectamente legal
statements.translation: Not every shell company is illegal. It can be used in a perfectly legal way

statements.quote: Nach Einschätzung der beteiligten Medien belegen die Unterlagen legale Strategien der Steuervermeidung, aber auch Steuer- und Geldwäschedelikte, den Bruch von UN-Sanktionen sowie andere Straftaten durch Kunden von Mossack Fonseca.
statements.translation: In the view of the media involved, the documents show legal tax-avoidance strategies, but also tax and money-laundering offences, breaches of UN sanctions, and other crimes by Mossack Fonseca clients.

statements.quote: Si dans la législation de la plupart des pays, les sociétés offshore ne sont pas illégales en elles-mêmes, c'est leur usage comme sociétés écrans dans l'évasion fiscale ou le blanchiment d'argent qui l'est.
statements.translation: If, in the law of most countries, offshore companies are not illegal in themselves, it is their use as screen companies in tax evasion or money laundering that is.

statements.quote: ICIJ同時承認，設立離岸公司不代表當事人一定有透過離岸公司進行不法活動
statements.translation: The ICIJ also acknowledged that setting up an offshore company does not mean the person necessarily used it for illegal activity.

statements.quote: O recurso a empresas offshore não é por si só ilegal nas jurisdições em que estão registradas. No entanto, durante a investigação os jornalistas verificaram que algumas das companhias de fachada mencionadas nos documentos podem ter sido usadas para fins ilegais, incluindo fraude, tráfico de droga e evasão fiscal.
statements.translation: Using offshore companies is not in itself illegal in the jurisdictions where they are registered. During the investigation, however, journalists found that some of the shell companies mentioned in the documents may have been used for illegal purposes, including fraud, drug trafficking and tax evasion.

statements.quote: يُزعم أن مكتب موساك فونسيكا ساعد رؤساء دول وشخصيات بارزة أخرى في التهرب الضريبي بإنشاء ملاجئ ضريبية غير قانونية في الأغلب.
statements.translation: It is alleged that the Mossack Fonseca office helped heads of state and other prominent people evade taxes by creating tax shelters that were illegal in most cases.

difference: English and Portuguese name Chinese leaders’ relatives but omit censorship despite substantial coverage of the 2016 disclosures. Arabic also omits censorship, while Icelandic omits China entirely; both are short accounts.
question: Which versions report censorship in China as well as leaders’ relatives?

statements.quote: the brother-in-law of China's paramount leader Xi Jinping

statements.translation: China’s state censorship instructed the country’s news sites to suppress every mention of the Panama Papers.

difference: German, French and Chinese date the removal to July 2017; Spanish reports it without a date. English omits it despite covering later events, while Portuguese largely remains in 2016 and the short Arabic and Icelandic accounts offer little international follow-up.
question: Which versions follow Sharif’s family disclosures through to his removal?

runs.note: German, French and Chinese date the removal to July 2017; Spanish reports it without a date. English omits it despite covering later events, while Portuguese largely remains in 2016 and the short Arabic and Icelandic accounts offer little international follow-up.

Spanish, German, French and Chinese report a 2017 Supreme Court removal or loss of eligibility, with French dating a unanimous five-judge vote to 28 July and Chinese adding a resignation announcement. Russian adds a lifetime political ban and a 2018 sentence in absentia of 10 years and a 10.6 million dollar fine. English and Portuguese name his children but not the 2017 outcome; Arabic and Icelandic do not report it, though Icelandic lists him among people connected to the documents.

German, French, Spanish, Russian and Chinese report Sharif's 2017 disqualification (Russian adds a 2018 10-year sentence). English mentions only his children among the named, without the disqualification; Portuguese, Arabic and Icelandic name him or his family only.

statements.quote: children of former Prime Minister of Pakistan Nawaz Sharif

statements.translation: On 28 July 2017, Pakistan’s Supreme Court removed Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif over corruption allegations connected with the Panama Papers.
